flows.title: Invite a creator to a campaign from the Creator Marketplace
steps: From the left navigation menu, select Discover, then Find Creators, then Creator Marketplace.
Use the tabs at the top of the Marketplace screen to filter for creators by a specific social channel.
Once you've selected a social channel, refine your search with the filter bar.
Select a creator's tile to view their profile, and on the profile slideout, select the Invite drop-down menu.
To invite the creator to your creator campaign only, select Invite to campaign and choose the appropriate campaign.
To invite a creator from the marketplace, they'll need to have an active impact.com account.
